host.name: EinkChess
host.description: Free browser chess app built for E-ink e-readers (Kindle, Kobo, Boox): play a 10-level AI bot, solve Lichess tactics puzzles from 400 to 3400 ELO, and review finished games. Pure ES5, no account, no install, everything runs on the device.

entries.description: Static, CORS-enabled JSON dataset of tactical chess puzzles bucketed by rating from 400 to 3400 ELO, refreshed weekly from the Lichess open puzzle database. Each record carries a FEN, the UCI solution line, a difficulty rating and tactical theme tags. No authentication required.
representativeQueries: give me a chess puzzle rated around 1600
find a mate in two tactics problem
where can I download free chess tactics puzzles as JSON
chess puzzles with fork and pin themes by ELO
open chess puzzle dataset with FEN and solution moves

entries.description: OpenAPI 3.1 description of the read-only puzzle data endpoints served from einkchess.fun, including the manifest format and the puzzle record schema.
